collection.description: A couple wants matching rings, but they disagree about precious metal and family tradition.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A couple wants matching rings, but one partner hates the idea of precious metal while the other wants a family tradition.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: They treasure the lightweight design, though one ring breaks and must be repaired.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The old material carries memories and requires delicate negotiations with relatives.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The pair discover that matching intentions matter more to them than matching materials.
